name: Snow Report 2026-10-20 09:00:00
report:
Oktoberfest has concluded for the year. Thanks for coming out to polka with us. 

We are currently in shoulder season. The hiking and biking trails remain open. Summer Activities and the Scenic Tram are closed for the season. The Tram is scheduled to reopen in winter.

Speaking of winter, save the date. Opening Day is scheduled for November 27, conditions dependent.

Still want some mountain time? The Cliff Spa is open, so you can treat yourself to a relaxing massage before taking a dip in the rooftop pool. Many of Snowbird's restaurants are also operating throughout the week. Enjoy a decadent steak at the Steak Pit or enjoy the view from the 10th floor of The Cliff Lodge at The Aerie.

Can't wait to see you up here!
